test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) and continue the given series.

KMI, IKG, GIE, ?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

K - 2 = I; I - 2 = G; G - 2 = E

M - 2 = K; K - 2 = I; I - 2 = G

I - 2 = G; G - 2 = E; E - 2 = C

Hence **the correct answer is **EGC.
